section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the 'Perceived Sociocultural Influences on Body Image and Body Change Questionnaire' (McCabe & Ricciardelli, 2001) and its adaptation for 'this study'. For this study, questions about parents were replaced with those about romantic partners, and a reduced set of 14 items was administered to assess perceived appearance pressures from partners, friends, and media.
